summary: The StaffExpertise module manages a staff member's Skills, Interests, and Professions (Disciplines and SubDisciplines), storing up to five of each per staff. It provides logic for CRUD operations, validation rules to prevent duplicates or invalid combinations, and supports comments per staff profile. Data is organized in edit/view objects and can be updated in bulk or per field.
purpose: To enable the entry, update, validation, and retrieval of a staff member’s skills, interests, professions, and related details, ensuring data integrity (such as no duplicates or invalid relationships) and providing mechanisms for comments, current employment tracking, and field-level validation.

workflows.name: Staff Expertise Data Entry and Update
steps: User retrieves their Skills, Interests, and Professions through StaffExpertiseSearch (by ExpertiseType).
Data is loaded into StaffExpertiseEdit objects, exposing lists and field mappings for update.
User updates any of up to 5 Skills, Interests, or Professions, including details, codes, and current employment status.
User may add or edit a comment.
On submission, IsValid is called to validate all field values (see validations).
If valid, StaffExpertises.StaffExpertiseUpdate is called for each non-empty skill, interest, and profession.
Errors are returned to the session if any validation fails (no update occurs).

business_rules: A staff member may record up to five skills, interests, and professions.
No duplicate codes are allowed among skills, interests, or profession (discipline/subdiscipline) sets.
If a discipline is selected, a subdiscipline must also be selected (cannot be -1).
Details for a skill or interest are recorded only if CodeID is zero.
CurrentEmployment can be tracked only for professions.
Comments are free-form and linked to the staff profile.
validations: All SkillCodeIDs, InterestCodeIDs, and DisciplineID/SubDisciplineID combinations must be unique across their respective lists (no duplicates).
For each profession entry, if DisciplineID > 0, SubDisciplineID must not be -1.
If validation fails, user receives an error and nothing is updated.
calculations: Skill, interest, and profession details shown or editable are conditional on the Count of the respective lists and the CodeID values.
If CodeID is zero for a skill/interest, user-provided details are stored; otherwise, the code's label is used.
conditions: Fields are only editable if their corresponding list index contains data.
Profession fields include tracking for current employment (boolean per entry).
system_behavior: All operations are session-aware; session ID is required for all updates and queries.
Validation occurs before any update to prevent duplicates or invalid combinations.
Database stored procedures are invoked for actual data changes.
dependencies: Requires HSPnetSession (for per-user context and DB access).
Uses stored procedures: StaffExpertiseSearch, StaffExpertiseUpdate, StaffExpertiseUpdateComment.
Depends on resource strings for error messages.
exceptions: Validation errors (such as duplicates or missing required subdisciplines) halt the update and return an error message to the session.
If a discipline is selected without a subdiscipline, or duplicates are present, the update fails.
content_gaps: Some field-level UI behaviors and complete error message text are invoked from resource files and not fully detailed.
Interaction with other modules beyond staff expertise is not described.
Some implementation details of StaffExpertiseSearch, StaffExpertiseUpdate, and StaffExpertiseUpdateComment procedures are not included, only usage is detailed.
